about_the_game:
Primordial Fate is a 2D, pixel-art, point and click horror/adventure game where you control multiple characters in a fast-paced, narrative driven plot. With minimal inventory and puzzles, your ending is determined based on how thorough you are in your exploration. Using a mouse based two-click LOOK/INTERACT system (full controls are listed within the game), you can explore or physically interact with any highlighted point of interest. Boasting three and a half unique endings, be sure to save often and read everything you can!

STORY DESCRIPTION:

Barrett and his sister Lilly are excited for their trip to beautiful Antwostend. What they do not know is that something ancient and evil has been orchestrating their arrival for centuries... plotting and waiting. Can they escape fate, or is their future already written in the stars?

VOICE ACTING NOTE:

Game uses optional AI voice acting which can be disabled/enabled from the options menu if desired. The game was made without voice acting in mind, voices were added post production as a option for those who are interested.

content_descriptors.notes: Game involves the death of main character in multiple ways.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: Pentium or higher
  • Memory: 256 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX compatible graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card

short_description: A narrative driven, 2D, point and click horror/adventure game (using a two-click LOOK/INTERACT system), where you control multiple characters at various points of the game. With multiple endings and deaths, this fast paced story plays like an 80s horror movie!
